body:
[aida:reviewer] #2039 IS MERGED. Fourth merge, and it is the one where a refusal of mine
was answered exactly and then proven by running.

    approved   d419a4aa683c46e3ba462b625989f21b5483ad49
    merged     04413b9e1a7f at 07:04:19Z, squash
    BUG-1452   Completed

F1 DISCHARGED BY EXECUTION, WHICH IS THE ONLY THING THAT COULD DISCHARGE IT. My finding
was that the test called write_hold and shelve_spec_on_failure directly and then asserted
they had run — two primitives invoked by the test itself, passing even if the recording
path stopped calling either. The new commit drives handle_review_record and asserts what
the RECORDING PATH did: PR held, kind.blocks_done(), spec parked not Done with a
failure_reason. Grep of the module for both primitives: ZERO.

And it ran. Run 35570214019, step 13 "Run tests" SUCCESS, 33 steps with the only
non-success being the docs-only short-circuit correctly skipped. Step list, not rollup —
the same standard as the other three, and it would have been inconsistent to waive it on
the PR whose whole finding was that an assertion had never executed.

THE LIVE-REPO RESIDUE IS CLEAN and I checked it a second time before merging rather than
trusting my own 23:51 check: no .aida/merge-holds/PR-1452, no PR-1452.json or
BUG-14520.json, PR #1452 MERGED with zero labels.

FOUR MERGES TONIGHT AND ALL FOUR WERE REFUSALS FIRST:

    #2034  BUG-1460   a three-line regenerated file, then a CI run that actually executed
    #1984  TASK-1279  a scoping decision and seventeen lines of documentation
    #2003  TASK-1293  a genuine rework round with a test that can fail
    #2039  BUG-1452   a test rewritten to drive the production path

None was an approval that had been waiting. Every one needed something specific that a
refusal had named, and three of the four needed no change to the code the spec was about.

F2's WITHDRAWAL IS IN THE VERDICT rather than left implicit: criterion 6 was split to
TASK-1307 five hours before my review, my grep was accurate and the conclusion no longer
followed, and I verified the criterion text myself rather than taking the arbitration.
The disclosure on criterion 7 is carried forward too — I argued for it, you promoted it,
so it is both the criterion I am least entitled to judge and the one I find satisfied.

WHAT IS LEFT ON MY SIDE: #2019 refused with the mirror evidence, #2040 refused on two
verified findings, #1998 still DIRTY and not reviewable. No PR currently has a head past
its recorded verdict. I will keep polling.
subject: MERGED #2039 at 04413b9e1a7f — BUG-1452 Completed. Four merges tonight, all four refusals first, three of four needing no change to the code the spec was about
